items.title: Decidability of inhabitation in the bounded parallel intersection type system
items.author: Andrej Dudenhefner; Aleksy Schubert; Jakob Rehof

items.difficulty_reason: The author bounds inhabitant search through a nonstandard subformula argument for relation-controlled type vectors. Subderivations initially have assumptions that are strict subsets of subformulae; the proof saturates those assumptions while preserving dimension and information flow. Combining inversion, vector transformations, subject reduction and alternating search yields a 2-EXPTIME upper bound and EXPTIME at fixed dimension. These are one parameterized main result; the supporting lemmas are not separate inventory.
